C-RELEASE-CONNECTOR-TRIGGER-306.Summary: Allow the existing single Release workflow to be started through the GitHub write connector by moving one reusable release-run ref to exact current main, without restoring automatic main fan-out, polling or version-specific release automation.
C-RELEASE-CONNECTOR-TRIGGER-306.Problem: The current release contract is workflow_dispatch-only. The connected GitHub write surface can update refs and inspect Actions but cannot invoke workflow_dispatch directly, so publishing 0.4.3 would otherwise require a manual UI action or a temporary workflow. Temporary workflows, cross-workflow orchestration and automatic release work on ordinary main pushes are explicitly prohibited.

Goals.Goal: Keep .github/workflows/release.yml as the only version-neutral release workflow.
Retain workflow_dispatch from main for human operation.
Add one persistent release-run push trigger that starts the same workflow only when that ref equals exact current main.
Keep ordinary pull requests and ordinary push/merge events in main free from release-scale jobs.
Preserve the existing build-once, checksum, install/update/rollback, Project Control and seven-asset publication contract.
Make the trigger reusable for later releases through a fast-forward ref update instead of new workflows or probe commits.

Constraints.Constraint: The exact base is main 51bf56d2690d3bf1d44e3d5f8f67e041288d04d7 and issue 306 remains open until v0.4.3 is published and verified.
No application/domain behavior, SQLite schema, applied migration, immutable source/evidence, PIN or ACL semantics change.
release-run is a release pointer, not a development branch; stale or non-main SHA must fail in release-preflight.
Release must not gain a push trigger for main, pull_request trigger, workflow_run trigger, polling loop, gh workflow run recovery or version-specific workflow.
Production remains Docker-free; the existing disposable Debian reference environment is unchanged.
Exact main is checked before release verification, before build and before publication.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Change the 0.4.3 product functionality or annual protocol import.
Change schema 31, migrations, installer internals, backup format or package policy.
Automatically release every merge to main.
Add a second release workflow or a one-off workflow for 0.4.3.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: .github/workflows/release.yml remains the single workflow named Release and supports workflow_dispatch plus push only for branches: [release-run].
release-preflight accepts only workflow_dispatch:refs/heads/main or push:refs/heads/release-run and requires GITHUB_SHA to equal the current main SHA.
No ordinary push or merge to main starts release-scale work.
The release workflow has no workflow_run or pull_request trigger, no gh workflow run, no Actions polling and no sleep-based wait loop.
Project verification, critical browser, build-once artifact, systemd install/update/rollback, Project Control and seven checked assets remain unchanged.
Documentation validation accepts the release-run trigger but rejects a Release push trigger for main.
C-RELEASE-WORKFLOW-SIMPLIFY-309 moves from active approved to archive applied with identical content except root lifecycle status.
The exact-head PR passes ordinary Проверка and GRACE / gate before squash merge.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: One universal Release workflow, ordinary main development unchanged, a reusable exact-main release-run pointer, and no external orchestration.
